desc: Implement the exact-v2 residue bucketing solution: parse input, compute diag = sum of odd parts of A_i, accumulate pairs with v2(A_i+A_j)=t via complementary residue matching mod 2^(t+1), then print (total+diag)//2.
Validate against all three provided sample inputs (5, 384, 20241214) and edge cases.
Optimize with bit-reversed block splitting so each level runs in O(N) via binary search and prefix sums.
Confirm no double counting across t (modulus 2^(t+1) partitions ordered pairs exactly once) and integer divisions are exact.
